harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured `/srv/data` on a dedicated Btrfs filesystem, captured a read-only snapshot, modified the live data, and restored it exactly from the snapshot. A boot-mount issue discovered during the first restart was corrected; a repeat restart proved persistent mounts, snapshot availability, restored hashes, and healthy filesystem state.
actions_performed: Created a persistent Btrfs filesystem with active and snapshot subvolumes.
Created representative application data and the read-only `before-change` snapshot.
Changed, deleted, and added data after snapshot creation.
Replaced the modified active subvolume with a writable snapshot clone.
Corrected fstab to attach the backing image using a loop device at boot.
Restarted node1 and verified recovery with a changed boot ID.

evidence.requirement: Application data is maintained under `/srv/data` on a snapshot-capable filesystem
evidence.summary: Shows the Btrfs filesystem/subvolume layout and persistent active/top-level mounts.

evidence.requirement: An earlier filesystem snapshot captures the application data
evidence.summary: Shows matching active/snapshot metadata and SHA-256 hashes, plus the read-only snapshot UUID and creation metadata.

evidence.requirement: The directory was modified after snapshot creation
evidence.summary: Proves changed configuration, changed symlink, deleted original database, added transient file, and expected snapshot differences.

evidence.requirement: Restore the exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: Shows rollback from the retained snapshot, original hashes and metadata restored, recursive comparison identical, and a clean Btrfs scrub.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot ID was `81f84a39-4836-4c1a-9c2e-147f68a72d68`; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart ID changed to `0c10b519-07c1-43fe-8158-0c9c6f2f84c9`; both mounts recovered, snapshot remained read-only, live data remained identical to it, device error counters were zero, and no units failed.

attempts.summary: Configured `/srv/data` on a dedicated Btrfs filesystem, captured a read-only snapshot, modified the live data, and restored it exactly from the snapshot. A boot-mount issue discovered during the first restart was corrected; a repeat restart proved persistent mounts, snapshot availability, restored hashes, and healthy filesystem state.
